description: Configuration for a Xyberos application. Generated from the Settings dataclasses by `xyberos check --schema`; do not edit it by hand.

ai.description: One table per AI provider. Core validates the shape and leaves every AI concept to the adapter that reads it, so this schema describes no keys.

plugins.description: One table per plugin, keyed by the plugin's name. Each plugin validates its own section against the config_type it declares, and rejects unknown keys.

schema_version.description: The configuration format version. Required from the first public format.

title: xyberos.toml
